_source: Reconstructed from the ticket's description of production c42a126f 'How TX Reward Splits Work' (2026-10-09 23:03 PDT). The exact published text is not in this repo; the failing lines quoted by the fact-checker are reproduced verbatim here: 'split between two parties', 'exact take home', 'delegate ten tokens or ten thousand, the percentage of the pool remains the same'.
title: How TX Reward Splits Work

hook.text: Who actually gets paid when you stake on TX?

introduction.topicIntro: Rewards do not simply land in your wallet.
introduction.valueProposition: Here is how TX splits staking rewards, and what comes off the top first.
introduction.credibility: We run a TX validator, so we see this every day.

sections.title: The Split
content: When you stake on TX, your rewards split between two parties: you and the validator.

sections.title: Your Take
content: Your exact take home depends on the validator's commission.

sections.title: Pool Share
content: Delegate ten tokens or ten thousand, the percentage of the pool remains the same.

conclusion.title: Takeaways
recap: Rewards split in more than one way.
The community pool takes its share first.
conclusion.finalThought: Check the details before you assume a clean split.

callToAction.subscribe: Subscribe for plain talk on the TX ecosystem.
callToAction.comment: Ask us how the community pool works.
